days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Todtnauberg
stops.detail: It first flows through the high valley of Todtnauberg, which is open to the southwest and characterized by meadows.

stops.name: Schatzstein
stops.detail: At a distance of 300 meters east of the upper waterfall step is the Schatzstein monolith.

days.title: Waterfall Clefts and Lower Slopes
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Hangloch
stops.detail: Below the Hangloch spur, the valley floor is forested, and the stream suddenly plunges into a rocky cleft with two drop steps a few meters high.

stops.name: Stiebenmatte
stops.detail: After a final 4-meter-high step, the Stübenbächle rushes another 140 meters steeply down to the Stiebenmatte and then to the confluence with the Schönenbach.
